rules.name: grasa-drift-vol-interp-cfs
rules.sql: WITH vd AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3) AS client, upper(trim(c.product_code)) AS product, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu AND ((upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'ACM' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM CT') OR (upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'IOL' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM BO') OR (upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'PGE' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM S')) ), base AS ( SELECT sec.client, sec.product, si.security_id, si.derivative_type, si.vol1_id, si.strike1, upper(cpm.call_put_id) AS cp, CASE WHEN cv.p1_vol > 0 THEN cv.p1_vol WHEN shared_cv.p1_vol > 0 THEN shared_cv.p1_vol END AS overlay_vol FROM sec JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(si.business_unit) = :bu AND si.security_id = sec.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.derivative_type_call_put_id_mapping_table cpm ON upper(cpm.derivative_type) = upper(si.derivative_type) LEFT JOIN opera.calculated_settle_vol_table cv ON cv.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(cv.business_unit) = :bu AND cv.security_id = si.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.calculated_settle_vol_table shared_cv ON shared_cv.tenant_id IS NULL AND upper(shared_cv.business_unit) = :bu AND shared_cv.security_id = si.security_id WHERE si.derivative_type ILIKE '%option%' OR si.derivative_type ILIKE 'amer%' OR si.derivative_type ILIKE '%call%' OR si.derivative_type ILIKE '%put%' ), v AS ( SELECT b.*, lo.strike AS lo_k, lo.settle_vol AS lo_v, hi.strike AS hi_k, hi.settle_vol AS hi_v FROM base b LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.strike, s.settle_vol FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND s.vol_id = b.vol1_id AND s.value_date = :cob AND upper(s.call_put_id) = b.cp AND s.strike <= b.strike1 ORDER BY s.strike DESC LIMIT 1) lo ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.strike, s.settle_vol FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND s.vol_id = b.vol1_id AND s.value_date = :cob AND upper(s.call_put_id) = b.cp AND s.strike >= b.strike1 ORDER BY s.strike ASC LIMIT 1) hi ON true ), r AS ( SELECT v.*, CASE WHEN lo_k = strike1 THEN lo_v WHEN lo_k IS NULL THEN hi_v WHEN hi_k IS NULL THEN lo_v ELSE lo_v + (hi_v - lo_v) * (strike1 - lo_k) / NULLIF(hi_k - lo_k, 0) END AS legacy_vol, (lo_k = strike1) AS exact_hit FROM v ) SELECT client, product, derivative_type, security_id, strike1, exact_hit, overlay_vol AS node_vol, legacy_vol, round((coalesce(overlay_vol, legacy_vol) - legacy_vol)::numeric, 8) AS vol_diff, round((100 * (coalesce(overlay_vol, legacy_vol) - legacy_vol) / NULLIF(legacy_vol, 0))::numeric, 4) AS vol_diff_pct FROM r ORDER BY abs(coalesce(overlay_vol, legacy_vol) - legacy_vol) DESC NULLS LAST
